perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Wallet Pay remains a fresh interoperability expansion across NFC, QR and online payments with named wallet partners.
A reported $167.5M Visa/Mastercard ATM-fee settlement adds a fresh independent regulatory/antitrust risk signal; settlement economics are bounded and do not establish broader network impairment.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Partner breadth supports distribution potential, but scaled transaction volume and incremental economics remain unproven; regulatory settlements remain an execution cost/risk rather than evidence of product failure.

unknowns: future regulatory remedies beyond the bounded settlement

sources.origin: New York Post reporting on court settlement

lineage.searchStrategy: reused current primary evidence and added materially different independent regulatory-risk source
